blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.auth.createUser` method used to send requests to Medusa's Authentication API routes. It can be used for admin users, customers, or custom actor types.

This method creates or links the `user` (admin) actor for a redirect-based
authentication provider after a successful callback. An existing user with
a matching, identity-provider-verified email is linked; otherwise a new
user is created. It sends a request to the [Provision Auth User API route](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#auth\_postauth\_provideruser).

The token returned by [callback](/references/js-sdk/auth/callback) is actorless until the user is
provisioned. Pass that token in the `Authorization` header, then call
[refresh](/references/js-sdk/auth/refresh) to obtain a token bound to the newly linked user.

```ts
const token = await sdk.auth.callback("user", "okta", queryParams)
await sdk.auth.createUser("okta", { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` })
await sdk.auth.refresh()
```

types.name: provider
types.description: The authentication provider instance ID. For example, `okta`.

types.name: headers
types.description:
Headers to pass in the request, typically the `Authorization`
bearer token returned by the callback.
